description: Prices one complete analysis package from word counts alone and returns the price in credits and USD, the model and reasoning effort that would be used, what is included and which reports are available. Read-only: nothing is stored and nothing is charged. Send counts only (`input_word_counts`, optionally `input_bytes`) and never transcript text. Check `valid` and `errors` in the result. Always call it, and show the user the price, before qualitative_start_analysis, which needs `price_credits`, `model` and `effort` of this quote. No account needed; with an API key that has credits:read the result also shows the account balance.

analysis_brief.description: The research objective and optional context; the server counts its words.

input_bytes.description: UTF-8 size per input slot in bytes; sharpens the token-based cost floor. Defaults to an estimate from the words.

input_word_counts.description: Words per input slot (all files of the slot together). Counts only, never content.

language.description: Analysis output language, a BCP 47 code such as en, cs or de.

report_language.description: Language of the selected reports, when different.

selected_reports.description: Report types from the preset's `reports` (available ones only).

name: qualitative_quote_analysis
title: Quote an analysis price
